sloka: हते तु लवणे देवाः सेन्द्राः साग्निपुरोगमाः ।ऊचुः सुमधुरां वाणीं शत्रुघ्नं शत्रुतापनम् ।। ७.७०.१ ॥
transliteration: hate tu lavaṇe devāḥ sendrāḥ sāgnipurogamāḥ ।ūcuḥ sumadhurāṁ vāṇīṁ śatrughnaṁ śatrutāpanam ।। 7.70.1 ॥

translations.english: Indeed, after Lavana was killed, the gods, led by Indra and with Agni at their forefront, spoke very sweet words to Shatrughna, the tormentor of enemies.
